title: Flooded garage and lost letters and records
summary: The 1965 storm flooded the garage and destroyed books and records.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You see, we didn't take, we didn't take all this wood to make this, put it up this, you know, in the back there, racks and all that you could put it up. When we first moved out here, we moved everything, but we, I still stayed in the storm until October the 1st. We moved out here in June. In September we had that storm. And that side of our garage there, one side is the, you got the, well, the slay asbestos, the slates, and the other side is the tapollion, you know. And boy, it just, and not only that, but the water came in back there about a foot, about a foot high. And it not only came from this way, but it came in that way too. And man, it's... From the top and the sides. Yeah. And George, we lost the books we had, we lost a lot of records. We lost a lot of records. We had records, we had a lot of records, the phonograph records, and things. We lost a lot of things.

Yeah, I'd like to have gotten out there and seen your stuff, you know. Gosh. That was such an awful storm. It rained and, come through four floors. Yeah, man, it sure was Karen. And I was wearing my white shampoos.
What a funny thing, man. If I'd left your stuff up on... Yeah. Yeah.
